verdict.rationale: Drata's API documents control-to-requirement mappings: List Requirements for Control, Reset Control Requirement Mappings, Compare Control Requirements, and frameworks with their own requirements. This implies one control can map to requirements in multiple frameworks. The pack shows only endpoint names, though, with no description of SOC 2 work automatically counting toward ISO 27001 or HIPAA, and no overlap view. Missing for 10: explicit docs on automatic cross-framework mapping of controls and evidence, named SOC 2/ISO 27001/HIPAA coverage, a UI or report showing framework overlap, independent or hands-on corroboration.
